en: Multiview postcard with a brown border. The main image on the left shows an ornate stone fountain with sculpted animal heads and shields, standing in front of 19th‑century style buildings on a city street. On the right are three studio photographs of richly decorated ceramic pieces: a floral bowl with bright pink flowers on green legs, a tall two‑handled vase with intricate patterns, and a bulbous vessel with red and black floral motifs. The reverse side is a standard divided back with address lines, stamp boxes, and Hungarian text indicating the city Pécs and the Budapest publisher.
